about: Pages built by site/pages_more.py. Each entry: path inside dist, and the extra checks for that page. Selectors and states are the page's own; a self-test implementing these lives with the page author (see /tmp/aib-more/check.mjs while the site is in review).

checks.what: at >= 1180px, no two visible nodes, group headings or lane headings overlap, in either view, with or without a question
at >= 1180px, no month label on the time axis sits under an event card
no node's text overflows its card (scrollHeight/Width <= clientHeight/Width + 1), and no chip label is cut

picking each question lights more than one node or dimension chip on the tree view; on the world view too, except june_price_volume, which stops at the first cut and finds no cause, so only the metric lights
picking a question shows its path panel with at least 4 steps and a link to its report
clicking a node opens the detail panel with at least: what it is, source, status, what would overturn it; Escape closes it and focus returns to the node
below 1180px the canvas becomes a list: SVG edges hidden, no horizontal scroll at 390
contrast >= 4.5 for all text, except nodes faded on purpose while a question or a node is picked (.gm-on/.gm-sel .gm-node:not(.lit, .near, .picked))
no internal words or field names in the page text, the step templates or the detail data (#gm-data): ontology, 切一刀, 槽位, 覆盖率, slot, snake_case ids, dimension=value
390: no horizontal scroll; wide tables scroll inside their own box (.ik-scroll), not the page

each accepted sentence is highlighted in the weekly report and numbered to match its record
the four counts, the comparison with the hand-written workspace and the list of differences are shown
the formed workspace's answers table has one row per question asked of it
